name: Alex Bar Centrale
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Alex Bar Centrale in Füssen**

Discover the cozy charm of **Füssen** at the **Alex Bar Centrale**, where traditional Bavarian hospitality meets a relaxed atmosphere. Savor authentic local flavors, from hearty **Schweinshaxe** to crisp **Weißbier**, and enjoy the warm ambiance of this beloved spot.

Whether you're unwinding after a day of exploring the **Alps**, admiring the stunning **Hohenschwangau Castle**, or simply soaking in the picturesque scenery of **Tirol**, the **Alex Bar Centrale** is the perfect place to recharge.

Come for the drinks, stay for the stories—every visit feels like a little escape.

**Prost!** 🍻
